args.command:
cd /office; python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv,json
cap={'东港':9,'西湾':6,'南站':9,'北仓':6}
# 案号:(站,实占,锁定,额度,优先号,批文,基础)
info={'J01':('东港',0,0,7,0,'7003',5),'J02':('东港',6,0,8,1,'7013',6),'J03':('东港',1,1,8,1,'2020',4),
'J04':('西湾',0,0,8,2,'7032',5),'J05':('西湾',7,0,6,1,'7043',4),'J06':('西湾',1,1,5,1,'7052',2),
'J07':('南站',2,2,7,0,'7063',6),'J08':('南站',7,0,5,1,'7073',2),'J09':('南站',0,0,10,0,'2080',5),
'J10':('北仓',1,1,5,0,'7093',4),'J11':('北仓',2,0,7,2,'2100',5),'J12':('北仓',3,0,6,0,'2110',3)}
dx={'J01':2,'J02':2,'J03':4,'J04':3,'J05':2,'J06':3,'J07':1,'J08':3,'J09':5,'J10':1,'J11':2,'J12':3}
ver={'J01':5,'J02':5,'J03':2,'J04':6,'J05':5,'J06':2,'J07':6,'J08':6,'J09':2,'J10':5,'J11':4,'J12':4}
T={}
for st,c in cap.items():
    ks=sorted([k for k in info if info[k][0]==st],key=lambda k:(info[k][4],k))
    avail=c-sum(info[k][2] for k in ks)
    for k in ks:
        _,occ,lock,q,pri,_,_=info[k]
        net=max(0,q-lock); add=min(net,avail); avail-=add
        T[k]=lock+add
    print(st,'容量',c,'可用',c-sum(info[k][2] for k in ks),'顺序',ks,'→',{k:T[k] for k in ks})
print('目标',T,{st:sum(T[k] for k in T if info[k][0]==st) for st in cap})
d=[k for k in sorted(T) if T[k]<info[k][1]]; i=[k for k in sorted(T) if T[k]>info[k][1]]
print('减',[(k,info[k][1],T[k]) for k in d]); print('增',[(k,info[k][1],T[k]) for k in i])
print('无需指令',[k for k in sorted(T) if T[k]==info[k][1]])
json.dump({'T':T,'ver':ver,'info':{k:list(v) for k,v in info.items()},'cap':cap,'dx':dx},open('scratch/day10.json','w'))
EOF
